items.t: Caesars Palace Launches Second Major Renovation of Bacchanal Buffet, Reimagining Its Global Kitchens
items.sum: LAS VEGAS, November 18, 2026--Caesars Palace is reimagining Bacchanal Buffet for a new era. Following its 2021 refresh, one of the city's largest buffets is getting a second major renovation, with redesigned kitchens and fresh culinary offerings for summer 2027. items.sum: LAS VEGAS, November 16, 2026--THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, the Octavius Sky Villas and the Colosseum Presidential Villas at Caesars Palace each earned Gold honors in the 2026 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards, recognizing excellence across the travel and hospitality industry.
